title: Low-temperature ALD-grown SnOx interlayer for scalable and stable p–i–n perovskite solar cells and modules
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01332A, Paper
Asmaa Mohamed, Hock Beng Lee, Vinayak Vitthal Satale, Keum-Jin Ko, Barkha Tyagi, Do-Hyung Kim, Jae-Wook Kang
ALD-SnOx at 80 °C eliminates ETL defects at the PC61BM interface, achieving 19.2% PCE for devices, 14.12% for modules, and >90% retention after 3000 h, overcoming ALD sensitivity issues for stable, scalable, and commercially viable p–i–n PSCs.
